scope: Additional original-WWII-HLL official and community image candidates; metadata only, not a runtime manifest.

verification.method: Bounded public downloads; image decoding and original-image review; measured dimensions, bytes and SHA-256; independent comparison to retained original downloads. Three black role-icon variants and diagnostic canvases were inspected additionally but are not counted as candidates.

rightsNote: Official publisher pages and community repositories establish source provenance, not a blanket artwork license. Preserve individual rights/version notes; no game binaries or diagnostic previews are included.
